title: Doped silicon strip: free-carrier plasma dispersion of a guided plane wave (analytic)
description:
A y-periodic silicon strip (n0 = 3.476) uniformly doped with the signed net doping N_net (> 0 donors, < 0 acceptors), one ohmic contact at the x_lo end (drift_diffusion: uniform charge-neutral equilibrium everywhere, no current). semiconductor_em_plasma_dispersion turns the carriers into dn = -(a N + b P^0.8) (Soref-Bennett silicon at 1.55 um, SI units) on the em_fdfd_ez index; a 1.55 um plane-wave mode is launched toward +x at x_src. Stationary sweep N_net = -1e25..1e25 1/m^3 (holes left, electrons right).
Analytic: N = |N_net| / 2 + sqrt(N_net^2 / 4 + n_i^2) for n type (P = n_i^2 / N), mirrored for p type; n = n0 + dn uniform; the discrete plane-wave index n_eff = 2 asin(n k0 dx / 2) / (k0 dx) and the mode phase at x_down relative to the source -k0 n_eff (x_down - x_src), wrapped into (-pi, pi] (about -1.70 rad undoped, rising by up to 0.22 rad at 1e25 holes).
Derived values tab: N_mean (exact equilibrium, ~1e-7), dn_mean = mean of sqrt(eps_r) - n0 (the coupling identity; float32 eps limits it to ~2e-7 absolute, i.e. ~1e-3 relative at |N_net| = 1e23), n_eff_mid and dn_eff_mid = n_eff - n_eff(undoped) from the mid mode monitor (~1e-6 / ~1e-3) and phi_down = phase_positive of the down monitor (~1e-3 rad).
Sweep tab: dn_eff_mid, dn_mean and phi_down versus N_net with their dashed curves: linear in the electron branch, the 0.8 power in the hole branch (holes shift the index more at equal density).
Line profile tab (last sweep value, N_net = 1e25): eps_profile, the uniform (n0 + dn)^2 along the strip. Field tab: em.ez_abs, em.eps_r, semiconductor.N and P.

parameters.name: N_net
parameters.description: signed net doping in 1/m^3: > 0 donors (n type), < 0 acceptors (p type); the sweep runs -1e25..1e25

parameters.name: lambda0
parameters.description: vacuum wavelength of the FDFD solve

parameters.name: k_vac
parameters.description: vacuum wavenumber k0 in 1/m

parameters.name: n_si
parameters.description: undoped silicon index n0 (eps_r = n_si^2)

parameters.name: n_i
parameters.description: intrinsic carrier density in 1/m^3

parameters.name: a_sb
parameters.description: electron coefficient of dn in m^3 (Soref-Bennett 8.8e-22 cm^3)

parameters.name: b_sb
parameters.description: hole coefficient of dn in m^2.4 (1.347e-22)

parameters.name: c_sb
parameters.description: hole exponent of dn

parameters.name: Lx
parameters.description: strip length along x (CPML outside for EM, insulating semiconductor faces)

parameters.name: Ly
parameters.description: period along y (periodic EM boundaries)

parameters.name: dx_cell
parameters.description: uniform cell size; the lines below sit at cell centres

parameters.name: w_contact
parameters.description: ohmic contact width at the x_lo end

parameters.name: x_src
parameters.description: mode source line (cell 50 centre), launching toward +x

parameters.name: x_mid
parameters.description: mid mode monitor (cell 150 centre)

parameters.name: x_down
parameters.description: downstream mode monitor (cell 256 centre; the undoped phase sits near -pi/2, far from the wrap)

parameters.name: N_maj
parameters.description: majority carrier density in 1/m^3

parameters.name: N_min
parameters.description: minority carrier density in 1/m^3 (mass action)

parameters.name: N0
parameters.description: analytic electron density in 1/m^3

parameters.name: P0
parameters.description: analytic hole density in 1/m^3

parameters.name: dn_ref
parameters.description: analytic plasma-dispersion index change

parameters.name: n_doped
parameters.description: index of the doped strip

parameters.name: ksi0
parameters.description: half-cell phase n0 k0 dx / 2 of the undoped discrete plane wave

parameters.name: n_eff_cold
parameters.description: discrete plane-wave n_eff of undoped silicon

parameters.name: n_eff_ref
parameters.description: discrete plane-wave n_eff of the doped strip

parameters.name: dn_eff_ref
parameters.description: analytic n_eff shift

parameters.name: phi_down_raw
parameters.description: unwrapped analytic phase at the down monitor in rad

parameters.name: phi_down_ref
parameters.description: analytic phase_positive of 'down', wrapped into (-pi, pi]
